nodes.label: Phase 1 — Proof of Concept
nodes.desc: Validate the nuclear TEV-shuttle mechanism: can we sort fluorescent proteins from nucleus to mitochondria in planta?

custom.title: Method
custom.content: Confocal fluorescence microscopy (RFP nuclear, mTurquoise2 mitochondrial) in N. benthamiana leaf cells after Agrobacterium infiltration.

custom.title: Design Rationale
custom.content: Must prove nuclear→mito transport works before adding the RepA DNA-binding domain. Two-module system: Module 1 = cargo + shuttle signals, Module 2 = TEV protease + NLS.

custom.title: Key Result
custom.content: mTurquoise2 successfully relocalized to mitochondria within 48h post-infiltration. RFP remained nuclear. Shuttle mechanism confirmed.

nodes.label: Constructs
nodes.desc: Binary vectors for the PoC shuttle system.

nodes.label: GreenGate Level 1
nodes.desc: Individual modules assembled via GreenGate cloning.

nodes.label: GreenGate Level 2
nodes.desc: Final binary vectors combining Level 1 modules.

nodes.label: Controls
nodes.desc: Negative controls to confirm specificity of the shuttle mechanism.

nodes.label: Phase 2 — DNA Transport
nodes.desc: Transport exogenous DNA into plant mitochondria via RepA-mediated covalent binding. Detect successful integration through mitochondrial RNA editing at nad9.

custom.title: Method
custom.content: Co-transformation of RepA shuttle + DNA cargo constructs. RT-PCR to detect C→U RNA editing at nad9 as evidence of mitochondrial transcription.

custom.title: Design Rationale
custom.content: RepA binds ssDNA covalently via catalytic Tyr. After TEV cleavage, mtPre pulls the RepA-DNA complex into mitochondria. Cargo flanked by nad9 homology arms for recombination.

custom.title: Next Steps
custom.content: Obtain clean positive + negative control results in a single experiment. Test all four DNA cargo variants.

nodes.label: DNA Approach
nodes.desc: Primary strategy: deliver DNA cargo directly via RepA shuttle.

nodes.label: DNA Cargo Variants
nodes.desc: Different cargo designs testing LIR/SIR origins and T7 promoter configurations.

nodes.label: RepA Vectors
nodes.desc: RepA shuttle constructs for DNA binding and delivery.

nodes.label: RNA Approach (Alternative)
nodes.desc: Alternative strategy: use RNA-binding proteins to shuttle RNA into mitochondria. Currently on hold pending DNA approach results.

custom.title: Note
custom.content: Exploratory — based on earlier work by a previous master student. Will revisit if DNA approach hits a dead end.

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Functional Rescue
nodes.desc: Ultimate goal: restore mitochondrial function by delivering a corrective gene. Demonstrate phenotypic rescue via Complex I activity restoration.

custom.title: Method
custom.content: BN-PAGE (Blue Native PAGE) to detect Complex I assembly. Compare transformed vs. untransformed mitochondria.

custom.title: Success Criteria
custom.content: Restored Complex I band on BN-PAGE in transformed plants. Quantifiable by densitometry.

elements.label: pDC011
elements.desc: Module 1: UBQ10→RFP–TEVrs–mtPre–mTurquoise2–NES–TEVrs–NLS. Cargo + shuttle signals.

elements.label: pDC012
elements.desc: Module 2: UBQ10→mTurquoise2–TEV-Protease(Intron)–SV40-NLS. Nuclear TEV expression.

elements.label: pDC045
elements.desc: Complete PoC binary vector (pGBY1). Combines @pDC011 + @pDC012. Transformation successful, validated by microscopy.

custom.title: Cloning Notes
custom.content: GreenGate LVL2 assembly. Colony PCR: 4/6 positive. Sequencing confirmed correct assembly.

elements.label: pDC112 (ΔNES)
elements.desc: Negative control: @pDC045 without NLS–TEVrs–NES. No nuclear processing expected → mTurquoise2 stays nuclear.

elements.label: pDC113 (ΔTEVrs)
elements.desc: Negative control: @pDC045 without TEVrs between NES and mtPre. TEV cannot expose mtPre → no mito transport.

elements.label: Confocal Microscopy
elements.desc: Confocal imaging of @pDC045-infiltrated N. benthamiana leaves. MitoTracker co-staining for mitochondrial verification.

custom.title: Microscope Settings
custom.content: Zeiss LSM 880. RFP: 561nm ex / 580-630nm em. mTurquoise2: 458nm ex / 470-510nm em. MitoTracker: 633nm.

elements.label: Western Blot
elements.desc: Anti-GFP western to confirm TEV cleavage products in nuclear and mitochondrial fractions.

elements.label: pDC071 (Cargo v1)
elements.desc: DNA cargo v1: LIR–nad9-upstream(430nt)–150nt-reporter–nad9-downstream. No T7 site.

elements.label: pDC076 (Cargo v2)
elements.desc: DNA cargo v2: SIR (YBDV origin) instead of LIR. Testing alternative rolling-circle origin.

replicates.note: Some clones had deletions, clone 3 correct

elements.label: pDC079 (Cargo v3)
elements.desc: DNA cargo v3: LIR + T7 promoter for in vitro ssDNA synthesis. Enables pre-loading RepA with cargo.

elements.label: pDC083 (Cargo v4)
elements.desc: DNA cargo v4: optimized LIR + T7 site variant 2. Currently in cloning.

custom.title: Troubleshooting
custom.content: Ligation efficiency low. Switching to 30U/µL T4 ligase and 16°C overnight. Also testing Gibson assembly as alternative.

elements.label: pDC068
elements.desc: RepA shuttle backbone (no GFP). Intermediate for @pDC084.

elements.label: pDC069 (RepA-GFP)
elements.desc: RepA–GFP fusion for fluorescence localization tracking. Confirms RepA enters mitochondria.

elements.label: pDC084
elements.desc: Complete RepA binary vector: @pDC068 + @pDC012. Ready for co-transformation with cargo.

elements.label: RT-PCR (nad9 editing)
elements.desc: RT-PCR targeting nad9 C→U RNA editing sites. Positive result = cargo transcribed inside mitochondria.

replicates.note: No editing detected — possible contamination with nuclear DNA
Faint band after DNase treatment — needs replication

custom.title: Protocol
custom.content: RNA extraction → DNase I treatment → RT with gene-specific primer → PCR → Sanger sequencing of C→U positions.

elements.label: Fluorescence Microscopy
elements.desc: Co-localization of @pDC069 (RepA-GFP) with MitoTracker in co-transformed cells.

elements.label: pDC094
elements.desc: RNA shuttle construct. Delivers target RNA sequence for mitochondrial import.

elements.label: pDC095
elements.desc: GG LVL 1: Modified backbone for RNA-binding protein expression.

elements.label: pDC098
elements.desc: GG LVL 2: Combines @pDC095 + TEV module. Final RNA approach vector — not yet assembled.

elements.label: pDC111 (Y→A mutant)
elements.desc: Critical negative control: @pDC084 with Tyr→Ala mutation in RepA active site. Cannot bind DNA covalently.

custom.title: Mutagenesis
custom.content: Site-directed mutagenesis via overlap extension PCR. Tyr305→Ala. Primer pair validated by NEB Tm calculator.

elements.label: Empty Vector Control
elements.desc: pGBY1 empty backbone. Infiltrated alongside experimental constructs in every co-transformation.

elements.label: BN-PAGE (Complex I)
elements.desc: Blue Native PAGE to detect restored Complex I assembly in mitochondrial extracts from transformed tissue.

custom.title: Protocol
custom.content: Mitochondrial isolation → digitonin solubilization → BN-PAGE → Coomassie or in-gel activity staining.

elements.label: O₂ Consumption Assay
elements.desc: Oxygen consumption rate measurement to quantify restored mitochondrial electron transport chain activity.

elements.label: Growth Phenotype
elements.desc: Compare growth rates of transformed vs. untransformed plants under stress conditions that require functional Complex I.

elements.label: Chlorophyll Fluorescence
elements.desc: PAM fluorometry to assess photosynthetic efficiency as indirect measure of mitochondrial health.
